`hack/openapi-violation.list`|Removed `list_type_missing` rules for APIServer configuration fields; added `names_match` rules for PKI, PolicyIdentity, and machine-related fields; migrated Kubernetes rules from older API versions (v1alpha1, v1alpha3) to current versions (v1, v1beta2); added `streaming_list_type_json_tags` entries for new ClusterImagePolicy and InsightsDataGather list types.| |**Build Script Configuration**
